title: Hearty Crispy Chinese Millet Wonton Soup
description: A savory and filling Chinese-inspired soup featuring crispy millet wontons, served in a flavorful broth. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the millet flour and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add in the sesame oil and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into small balls and flatten each one into a thin circle.
Place a small spoonful of the cooked pork mixture in the center of each circle and fold the dough over to form a wonton.
Add the wontons to the wok and cook until crispy and golden brown.
Add the chicken broth and soy sauce to the wok and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
